author: Fun_Vegetable_88888
body: There are a lot of different ways to play a heratic. With t10 you live and die by ward so you need to make sure you invest in that stat and crit. Most of the damage dealing spells have a crit percentage and try to shoot for about 80% crit and get your ward as high as you can.  The celestial classes play different from regular heratic so there are a lot of different builds. Good non event stafs to find are the quatvanga and kaladanda. They are from arisen mammon, one of them is two handed, I dont remember which.

author: Sketutz
body:
Reach max crit with gems or near it taking into account spell crit chance. Wyrm song will increase it by 20% too.

Gears. Either go for 1h/shied or two handed for higher ward, slower killing builds but best survivability. 2h weapons have more slots for adornments. Or go glass cannon and dual wield (for sequencer spec) and dish out doublecasts (low ward, faster kills).

Take note of 2h staves like Trev and Yelm staff (dont make me spell the names). Those have spells that dont use mana, so you can zero your mana and hit as hard as you can (brilliant lights), I use these for dungeons. Doesnt have to be ornate to be useful.

There's a lot of variation in builds, you may want to use equipment sets for different use case. Manaflasks, blood pact (summoner in party), brilliant lights, vesta spells, fast cast Ultima etc. Will differ depending on which items you have.
